NOT_INITIALIZED: This counter has not been set up yet.
ALREADY_INITIALIZED: This counter is already set up.
SESSION_LOCKED: Locked after inactivity. Please log in again.
FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do this.
APPROVAL_REQUIRED: A supervisor needs to approve this.
INVALID_APPROVAL: That approval has expired or was already used.
ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many wrong PINs. Try again after {{until}}.
DATABASE: The database reported a problem. Your last action was not saved.
INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Your last action was not saved.

VALIDATION.PIN_NOT_DIGITS: The PIN must contain digits only.
VALIDATION.PIN_TOO_LONG: The PIN can have at most 8 digits.
VALIDATION.SELF_APPROVAL: A different staff member must approve.
VALIDATION.DEVICE_CODE_INVALID: Use a counter code from T01 to T09.
VALIDATION.STORE_NAME_INVALID: Enter the store name (up to 80 characters).
VALIDATION.OWNER_NAME_INVALID: Enter the owner's name (up to 60 characters).
VALIDATION.PRODUCT_NAME_TOO_LONG: The name can have at most 80 characters.
VALIDATION.PRODUCT_NAME_NOT_PRINTABLE: Use English letters for the product name: it prints on receipts and labels.
VALIDATION.PRODUCT_NAME_SI_TOO_LONG: The Sinhala name can have at most 80 characters.
VALIDATION.MIN_PRICE_INVALID: The lowest price must be between zero and the selling price.
VALIDATION.ATTRIBUTES_INVALID: Attributes need a name (up to 20 characters) and a value (up to 40); at most 10.
VALIDATION.SKU_INVALID: A SKU uses letters, digits or '-', up to 16 characters.
VALIDATION.SKU_TAKEN: Another product already has this SKU.
VALIDATION.BARCODE_INVALID: A barcode is 4–32 characters with no spaces.
VALIDATION.BARCODE_CHECK_DIGIT: This 13-digit barcode's last digit is wrong. Scan it again.
VALIDATION.BARCODE_TAKEN: Another active product already has this barcode.
VALIDATION.CODE_SEQUENCE_EXHAUSTED: This counter has used all its in-store codes. Enter a code by hand.
VALIDATION.BARCODE_ASSIGN_TOO_MANY: Too many products at once. Give barcodes to at most 10,000 at a time.
VALIDATION.CATEGORY_NAME_INVALID: Enter a category name (up to 60 characters).
VALIDATION.CATEGORY_NAME_TAKEN: A category with this name already exists here.
VALIDATION.CATEGORY_PARENT_INVALID: The parent category no longer exists.
VALIDATION.CATEGORY_CYCLE: A category can't be placed inside itself.
VALIDATION.CATEGORY_IN_USE: Move its products and sub-categories out first.
VALIDATION.BATCH_NAME_INVALID: Enter a batch name (up to 80 characters).
VALIDATION.BATCH_COST_INVALID: Enter valid amounts for the invoice and extra costs.
VALIDATION.BATCH_DATE_INVALID: The purchase date is not valid.
VALIDATION.BATCH_SUPPLIER_INVALID: Supplier details can have at most 120 characters.
VALIDATION.BATCH_NOTES_INVALID: Notes can have at most 500 characters.
VALIDATION.BATCH_NOT_DRAFT: This batch is already received, so it can't be changed.
VALIDATION.BATCH_EMPTY: Add at least one item before receiving.
VALIDATION.BATCH_ITEM_QTY_INVALID: Enter a quantity of 1 or more.
VALIDATION.BATCH_ITEM_COST_INVALID: Enter a valid cost per unit.
VALIDATION.PRODUCT_NOT_TRACKED: This product doesn't track stock, so it can't be received into a batch.
VALIDATION.QTY_INVALID: Enter a quantity of 1 or more.
VALIDATION.NO_OPEN_SESSION: Open a cash session on this counter first.
VALIDATION.SESSION_ALREADY_OPEN: A cash session is already open on this counter.
VALIDATION.DENOMINATIONS_MISMATCH: The notes and coins don't add up to the counted cash.
VALIDATION.DENOMINATION_INVALID: That note or coin count isn't valid.
VALIDATION.CHECKOUT_TOKEN_INVALID: This sale couldn't be identified. Start a new cart.
VALIDATION.CART_EMPTY: Add at least one item before taking payment.
VALIDATION.LINE_INVALID: One of the cart lines isn't valid.
VALIDATION.LINE_DISCOUNT_INVALID: An item discount can't be more than the line amount.
VALIDATION.BILL_DISCOUNT_INVALID: The bill discount can't be more than the bill.
VALIDATION.PAYMENT_MISMATCH: The payments must add up to the amount due exactly.
VALIDATION.PAYMENT_NEGATIVE: A payment can't be negative. There are no cash refunds.
VALIDATION.PAYMENT_INVALID: Only cash can be tendered with change, and never less than the amount.
VALIDATION.PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: This product is no longer for sale.
VALIDATION.QUICK_SALE_NAME_INVALID: Type the quick-sale name in English letters (up to 80 characters).
VALIDATION.APPROVER_LIMIT_TOO_LOW: The approver's limit doesn't cover this discount or price.
VALIDATION.PHONE_INVALID: Enter a Sri Lankan phone number, such as 077 123 4567.
VALIDATION.CUSTOMER_NAME_INVALID: The customer name can have at most 60 characters.
VALIDATION.VOID_NOTE_REQUIRED: Explain the reason when you choose "Other".
VALIDATION.ORDER_ALREADY_VOIDED: This sale has already been voided.
VALIDATION.VOID_OTHER_DEVICE: A sale can only be voided on the counter that made it.
VALIDATION.VOID_SESSION_CLOSED: This sale's cash session is closed, so it can't be voided. Goods are returned through an exchange.
VALIDATION.APPROVER_NOT_AUTHORISED: The approver isn't allowed to do this.
VALIDATION.CUSTOMER_ALREADY_ERASED: This customer's details have already been erased.
VALIDATION.CART_TOO_LARGE: This cart is too large to save.
VALIDATION.CART_INVALID: The saved cart couldn't be read.
VALIDATION.TOO_MANY_HELD: Too many held sales. Recall or finish one first.
VALIDATION.BACKUP_DEST_MISSING: That folder can't be found. Is the drive plugged in?
VALIDATION.BACKUP_DEST_READ_ONLY: That folder can't be written to.
VALIDATION.BACKUP_DISK_FULL: Not enough free space on that drive.
VALIDATION.BACKUP_EXISTS: A backup with this name already exists. Try again in a second.
VALIDATION.BACKUP_WRITE_FAILED: The backup couldn't be written. Was the drive removed?
VALIDATION.BACKUP_VERIFY_FAILED: The backup copy failed its check and was deleted. Try another drive.
VALIDATION.BACKUP_FAILED: The backup failed. Sales are not affected.
VALIDATION.OWNER_ROLE_OWNER_ONLY: Only an Owner can give or change Owner powers.
VALIDATION.OVERRIDE_CONFLICT: A permission can't be granted and denied at the same time.
VALIDATION.DISCOUNT_LIMIT_INVALID: The discount limit must be between 0% and 100%.
VALIDATION.BATCH_TOTAL_REQUIRED: Enter the invoice total: the cost can only be shared if it is known.
VALIDATION.BATCH_NO_WEIGHT: There is nothing to share the cost over (all retail prices are zero).
VALIDATION.BATCH_HAS_MOVEMENTS: Some of this batch has already sold or moved, so its costs can't change any more.
VALIDATION.BATCH_NOT_RECEIVED: Only a received batch can do that.
VALIDATION.BATCH_SYSTEM: The opening-stock and adjustment batches can't be reopened or closed.
VALIDATION.BATCH_ITEM_EXISTS: That product is already in this batch.
VALIDATION.BATCH_HAS_STOCK: {{detail}} unit(s) are still on hand: sell or write them off before closing.
VALIDATION.LOGO_INVALID: That header image can't be used: it must be at most 576 dots wide and 480 dots tall.
VALIDATION.RECEIPT_IMAGE_INVALID: That receipt picture can't be printed: it must be at most 576 dots wide and 6000 dots tall.
VALIDATION.LABEL_PROFILE_INVALID: Check the label printer settings (dpi 203 or 300, darkness 0–15, speed 1–6, shifts within 10 mm).
VALIDATION.LABEL_CALIBRATION_INVALID: Gaps and margins must be between 0 and 10 mm.
VALIDATION.LABEL_JOB_TOO_LARGE: That's more than 5,000 labels in one go.
VALIDATION.LABEL_PRODUCT_INVALID: One of the products no longer exists.
VALIDATION.LABEL_IMAGE_INVALID: The sticker picture doesn't match the chosen sticker size. Close the window and print again.
VALIDATION.LABEL_DPI_CHANGED: These stickers were drawn for a different printer resolution. Print them again.
VALIDATION.STOCK_INSUFFICIENT: Only {{detail}} on hand: you can't remove more than that.
VALIDATION.STOCK_NOTE_REQUIRED: Say why: a reason is required.
VALIDATION.COUNT_EMPTY: Add at least one product to the count.
VALIDATION.COUNT_DUPLICATE: A product appears twice in the count.
VALIDATION.QUICK_SALE_ALREADY_PROMOTED: This quick sale is already a product.
VALIDATION.CUSTOMER_NOTE_INVALID: The note can have at most 500 characters.
VALIDATION.PERIOD_INVALID: That period isn't valid: check the dates.
VALIDATION.EXPENSE_CATEGORY_EXISTS: A category with that name already exists.
VALIDATION.EXPENSE_CATEGORY_INACTIVE: That category is retired. Restore it or pick another.
VALIDATION.EXPENSE_DATE_INVALID: Pick a valid date, not in the future.
VALIDATION.EXPENSE_DRAWER_CASH_ONLY: Only cash can be paid from the drawer.
VALIDATION.EXPENSE_DRAWER_TODAY_ONLY: Drawer payments are for today only.
VALIDATION.EXPENSE_DRAWER_LOCKED: This expense moved drawer cash: its amount, date and method are fixed, and it can only be deleted while its shift is open.
VALIDATION.EXPENSE_TEXT_TOO_LONG: Paid to and note can have at most 200 characters.
VALIDATION.EXPORT_DIR_INVALID: That folder isn't available. Check the drive and pick it again.
VALIDATION.EXPORT_WRITE_FAILED: The file couldn't be written. Check the drive has space.
VALIDATION.SYNC_OFFLINE: The sync server can't be reached. Check the internet connection and try again.
VALIDATION.SYNC_UNAUTHORIZED: This counter's cloud identity was refused. Register the counter again.
VALIDATION.SYNC_PROTOCOL: The sync server sent an unexpected answer.
VALIDATION.SYNC_URL_INVALID: Enter the server address, starting with https://.
VALIDATION.SYNC_KEY_INVALID: Enter the project key exactly as shown in the Supabase dashboard.
VALIDATION.SYNC_EMAIL_INVALID: Enter the owner's cloud account email.
VALIDATION.SYNC_PASSWORD_REQUIRED: Enter the owner's cloud account password.
VALIDATION.SYNC_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is wrong.
VALIDATION.SYNC_STORE_OWNED_BY_ANOTHER_ACCOUNT: This store is registered to a different cloud account.
VALIDATION.SYNC_ACCOUNT_OWNS_ANOTHER_STORE: This cloud account already has a different store.
VALIDATION.SYNC_NO_STORE_FOR_ACCOUNT: This cloud account has no store yet. Register the first counter from its Settings → Sync.
VALIDATION.SYNC_DEVICE_IN_ANOTHER_STORE: This counter is registered to a different store.
VALIDATION.SYNC_DEVICE_CODE_TAKEN: Another counter in the store already uses this counter code.
VALIDATION.SYNC_DEVICE_CODE_MISMATCH: The cloud knows this counter under a different code.
VALIDATION.SYNC_NO_FREE_DEVICE_CODE: The store already has nine counters.
VALIDATION.SYNC_DEVICE_CANNOT_REGISTER: Sign in with the owner's account, not a counter's.
VALIDATION.SYNC_OWNER_NOT_SIGNED_IN: The owner's sign-in expired. Try again.
VALIDATION.SYNC_FUNCTION_NOT_CONFIGURED: The server's registration service isn't set up yet.
VALIDATION.SYNC_SERVER_ERROR: The sync server had a problem. Try again shortly.
VALIDATION.RESTORE_PENDING: This counter is finishing a restore. The Owner must finish it first.
VALIDATION.RESTORE_FILE_MISSING: The backup file can't be found.
VALIDATION.RESTORE_CORRUPT: This file is damaged or isn't a GayanShop backup.
VALIDATION.RESTORE_NOT_A_BACKUP: This file isn't a GayanShop counter backup.
VALIDATION.RESTORE_NEWER_SCHEMA: This backup was made by a newer version of the app. Update the app first.
VALIDATION.RESTORE_OTHER_STORE: This backup belongs to a different store.
VALIDATION.RESTORE_OTHER_COUNTER: This backup belongs to another counter ({{detail}}). Restore it on that counter.
VALIDATION.RESTORE_WRITE_FAILED: The restore couldn't write its files. Check the disk and try again.
VALIDATION.RESTORE_OWNER_ONLY: Only the Owner can finish a restore.
VALIDATION.RESTORE_NOT_PENDING: There is no restore to finish.
VALIDATION.RESTORE_NO_FREE_CODE: All nine counter codes are in use.
VALIDATION.RESTORE_MODE_UNAVAILABLE: That way of finishing the restore isn't available on this counter.
VALIDATION.SALESPERSON_UNKNOWN: No staff member has that salesperson number. Check the number and try again.
VALIDATION.SALESPERSON_INACTIVE: That staff member is disabled and cannot be credited with a sale.
VALIDATION.STAFF_NOT_FOUND: That staff member no longer exists.
VALIDATION.RETURN_INVALID: The goods being returned aren't valid for an exchange.
VALIDATION.RETURN_ITEM_UNKNOWN: One returned item isn't on that sale.
VALIDATION.RETURN_ORDER_VOIDED: That sale was voided, so nothing on it can be exchanged.
VALIDATION.RETURN_NOT_STOCKED: Only stocked items can be returned. Quick-sale lines can't.
VALIDATION.RETURN_QTY_EXCEEDS: More units were chosen than can still be returned.
VALIDATION.EXCHANGE_REPLACEMENT_TOO_LOW: The replacement must be worth at least the returned goods. There are no cash refunds or credit notes.
VALIDATION.VOID_EXCHANGE: An exchange, or a sale with returned goods, can't be voided.
VALIDATION.SESSION_NOT_CLOSED: That shift is still open; close it before printing its Z-report.
VALIDATION.PHONE_SEARCH_TOO_SHORT: Type at least 4 digits of the phone number.
VALIDATION.PRODUCT_HAS_STOCK: This product still has stock. Adjust its stock to 0 first, then delete it.

INVARIANT.LAST_OWNER: At least one active Owner must remain.
INVARIANT.BAD_CALENDAR_SETTINGS: The store's time settings are invalid.
INVARIANT.SYNC_IDENTITY_MISMATCH: The server answered for a different counter. Nothing was changed.
INVARIANT.RESTORE_CHAIN_MISMATCH: This counter's audit trail doesn't match the cloud's. Finish the restore as a new counter instead.
